en-US.longDescription: Kiten is a Japanese reference and study tool. It features an English to Japanese and Japanese to English dictionary, as well as a Kanji dictionary. For the Kanji dictionary there are multiple ways supported to look up characters.
en-US.name: Kiten

zh-CN.longDescription: Kiten 是一款日文参考与学习工具。它提供了英译日词典、日译英词典及日语汉字词典。日语汉字词典还支持多种方式查询字词。
